name: expiry-select
title: Expiry select
description: Choose how long something lasts: presets such as 7 days, 30 days or never, a custom date, and the resulting date written out under the field.
docs: value is an absolute calendar date such as "2026-12-02", or null for never, so what is stored cannot drift with the clock; onValueChange reports the date a choice comes to. presets are { label, days } counted from from (a date, a Date or a timestamp; default now, in timeZone, default UTC). A preset that would end after max (a date) is turned off and says where the limit is, and Custom date opens the house date picker, limited to between the start and max. The line under the field writes the date out ("Expires Tue 17 Nov 2026") or says "Never expires"; a date that has passed, or lies beyond max, marks the field invalid and says so there. allowNever adds the Never choice. The server render writes nothing that depends on the clock, so nothing mismatches. name sends the date, or never. labels changes the words, and locale the language the dates are written in (default en-US; en-GB writes "Tue 17 Nov 2026").
